summary: This note describes Boiron, a French manufacturer of homeopathic products. It has an operating presence in 59 countries and is described as the largest homeopathic manufacturer in the world. Figures given are from 2004, when it employed 2,779 people and had a turnover of €313 million, and the note says it is currently a member of the CAC Small 90 stock index.
one_line: Boiron is a France-headquartered maker of homeopathic products, the world's largest, operating in 59 countries.
key_facts: Boiron is a manufacturer of homeopathic products headquartered in France.
Boiron has an operating presence in 59 countries worldwide.
Boiron is the largest manufacturer of homeopathic products in the world.
In 2004, Boiron employed a workforce of 2,779.
In 2004, Boiron had a turnover of € 313 million.
Boiron is currently a member of the CAC Small 90 stock index.
